reply:

Las Islas del Rosario son una chulada para bucear, y siendo Advanced puedes hacer las 2 inmersiones con el equipo incluido.

Para las salidas desde Cartagena, el precio es **178 USD online** o **197 USD normal**. That sounds like a lovely way to enjoy the Rosario Islands! Since it’s been three years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required. It takes a separate day, so you could do the refresher on one day and your fun dives on another.

You can’t pay the full amount in cash at the dock; international guests book and pay online.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD (630.000 COP · 700.000 COP)
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD (655.000 COP · 727.000 COP)

msg: Buenas tardes. Soy de Medellín, buzo certificado desde hace años, tengo 70 años y me operaron de la rodilla hace un año. Quiero bucear con mis nietos de 9 y 13 años. ¿Qué podemos hacer los tres y cuánto cuesta?
reply:
Buenas tardes. ¡Qué bonito plan para disfrutar el mar en familia! No hay edad máxima para bucear; para ti, la operación de rodilla requiere valoración del equipo antes de confirmar si puedes participar.

Para buzos certificados, las salidas recreativas son para personas desde los 10 años. Tu nieto de 13 podría participar si está certificado; el de 9 no cumple la edad mínima para esas salidas. Bubble Makers es para niños de 8 a 10 años, en piscina o aguas muy poco profundas, con instructor PADI dedicado.

**Buceo certificado, precios por persona:**
- Desde Cartagena: 2 inmersiones, **630.000 COP online** o **700.000 COP precio normal**.
- Si ya están en las islas: 2 inmersiones, **440.000 COP online** o **489.000 COP precio normal**.

También hay paquetes:
- Desde Cartagena: 3 inmersiones (2 diurnas y 1 nocturna), **1.017.000 COP online** o **1.130.000 COP normal**; o 4 inmersiones en 2 días, **1.154.000 COP online** o **1.282.000 COP normal**.
- Ya en las islas: 3 inmersiones (2 diurnas y 1 nocturna), **665.000 COP online** o **739.000 COP normal**; o 4 inmersiones en 2 días, **720.000 COP online** o **800.000 COP normal**.

El equipo debe revisar tu caso por la operación de rodilla y coordinar las opciones para los tres.

En nuestro programa *DIVE TO HEAL* (buceo adaptado) el precio y la logística se coordinan de forma personalizada según la actividad y las necesidades de cada persona — por eso no es una tarifa fija de la web, la define un asesor evaluando tu caso para que la experiencia sea segura y a tu medida. 🤿

¿Quieres que te pase con un asesor para darte todos los detalles? 😊

msg: Buenas! Soy argentino, tengo Advanced de SSI con unas 40 inmersiones. Me interesa bucear con nitrox en las Islas del Rosario. Me sirve mi certificación SSI? Ustedes tienen nitrox?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

Las Islas del Rosario son un lugar chévere para bucear con Nitrox. Sí, tenemos tanques de Nitrox disponibles bajo pedido para buzos certificados en Nitrox; avísanos al reservar. Cuestan **10 USD por tanque** (**20 USD por dos inmersiones**).

También necesitas:
• Al registrarte recibirás una introducción digital. Debes completar lecturas y pruebas de conocimientos antes de la práctica.
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 18 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

Tu certificación Advanced de SSI acredita experiencia como buzo, pero para la **Especialidad PADI Nitrox** el requisito indicado es tener certificación **PADI Open Water Diver**. No puedo confirmar si tu certificación SSI cumple ese requisito; ¿quieres que te pase con un asesor para revisarlo?

msg: Hola, buceo con certificación CMAS una estrella y tengo 30 inmersiones. ¿Puedo bucear con ustedes?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Qué chévere que ya tengas 30 inmersiones! Para las salidas recreativas necesitas presentar tu carné de buzo certificado; puedes enviarnos una foto antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.

También necesitas:
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.
• Si llevas más de 2 años sin bucear, normalmente se requiere un refresh; los buzos muy experimentados (500+ inmersiones, Dive Master) los revisa un asesor del equipo. Si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu refresh y puedes bucear directamente. El refresher es el minicurso (piscina y una inmersión con instructor) y ocupa su propio día: ese mismo día no se hace la salida de buceo. Quien viene varios días hace el refresher el primero y bucea los demás.

Con tu certificación CMAS de una estrella, el equipo debe confirmar qué salida corresponde a tu nivel. ¿Quieres que te pase con un asesor para revisarlo?

msg: Hello, we're a family from Toronto staying at Hotel San Pedro de Majagua on the islands. Our kids are 9 and 11. What can they do? We parents would snorkel.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a lovely family day on the reefs! Since you’re staying at San Pedro de Majagua, pick-up is included.

- **Your 9-year-old** can snorkel (minimum age 6) or try **Bubble Makers**: a gentle introduction to diving in a pool or very shallow water, up to 2 m, with a dedicated PADI instructor. It doesn’t certify.
- **Your 11-year-old** can snorkel, take the **Dive Mini Course**, or start the **Open Water course**. Certified fun dives require an Open Water certification. Minors must be accompanied by a responsible adult.
- **You parents** can join the guided snorkeling tour: two reef sessions with snorkeling gear and a PADI professional. Pick-up is between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m., with return around 12:00–1:00 p.m.

The island snorkeling tour can be booked here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/snorkeling-already-on-the-island/25?language=en. Bubble Makers is arranged through a team advisor.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Dive Mini Course: 134 USD · 149 USD
• Bubble Makers (kids 8-10): 123 USD · 137 USD
• Snorkeling Tour: 45 USD · 50 USD
• PADI Open Water Course: 596 USD · 662 USD

Would you like to explore that option for your 9-year-old?

msg: Hello, I'm from Hamburg and I'm staying in Bocagrande next week. I'm Open Water certified but my last dive was three years ago. I'd like to dive this Thursday and I fly home on Friday at 10 in the morning. Is that possible, and what would it cost?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

For a daytime refresher on Thursday, you can fly from 7:00 a.m. on Friday, so your 10:00 a.m. flight meets the 18-hour minimum. The waiting time is counted from your last dive, not from when you return to Cartagena.

Since you’re certified and it’s been three years since your last dive, the refresher is the right option to consider. It’s booked as the Dive Mini Course, but the certified-diver refresher still requires the full 18-hour wait.

You can book here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en

The booking system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before for next-day bookings.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

msg: OK, then I'd rather dive on Wednesday. Is the refresher all I do that day, or can I also do normal dives? And how do I book?
reply:
The refresher takes the full day, so you can’t add regular dives that same day. It includes pool practice and one reef dive with an instructor. You can do regular dives on another day after completing the refresher.

Book the refresher online here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en

The 10% online discount is applied automatically. The website booking system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before; after that, you can still book online for the next available day.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

How many people would this be for: just you, or more? 😊

msg: Hola, quiero hacer el minicurso saliendo desde Cartagena. ¿Tengo que hacer alguna teoría online antes de ir?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Qué chévere que quieras probar el buceo! No tienes que hacer teoría online: la teoría se hace allí, el mismo día, junto con la práctica en piscina y una inmersión en el mar con instructor. El minicurso no requiere experiencia ni certificación previa y no certifica.

También necesitas:
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 12 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

La edad mínima es 10 años. Para reservar, puedes hacerlo aquí: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=es

msg: Buenos días. Mi esposo es buzo Advanced y yo estoy embarazada de cinco meses. Nos alojamos en Cartagena. ¿Puedo acompañarlo en la lancha y hacer snorkel mientras él bucea? ¿Cuánto costaría para los dos?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

Sí, puedes hacer snorkel en superficie durante el embarazo, siempre que tengas el visto bueno de tu médico. No se recomienda bucear con botella durante el embarazo. El snorkel se realiza en una zona distinta a la del buceo; según cuántas personas haya, pueden ir en la misma lancha o separarse por actividad.

El precio total para los dos depende de la moneda que les corresponda; te dejo los precios por actividad a continuación.

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
• Tour de Snorkeling: 126 USD · 140 USD (448.000 COP · 497.000 COP)
• Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día): 178 USD · 197 USD (630.000 COP · 700.000 COP)
• Paquete de 3 inmersiones (1 día, 2 diurnas + 1 nocturna): 287 USD · 319 USD (1.017.000 COP · 1.130.000 COP)
• Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas): 316 USD · 351 USD (1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP)

Te recomiendo el plan de *2 inmersiones en 1 día* en las Islas del Rosario. (Si prefieres más inmersiones, hay *paquetes* de 3 o más; dímelo.)

¿Ha pasado *más de 2 años* desde la última inmersión de alguno del grupo?

msg: Good morning, we are two Belgian divers (both Advanced) staying at a hotel on Isla Grande from the 8th to the 12th. We would like to dive on two different days and do one night dive. We fly home from Cartagena on the 13th at 7 a.m. What do you recommend, and can we pay in euros in cash when we arrive?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Good morning! Diving from Isla Grande is a lovely way to explore the Rosario Islands. Since you’re already on the islands and want to dive on two different days with one night dive, the **5-dive package over 2 days** fits well: 4 daytime dives and 1 night dive. You’ll need to stay on the islands for the night of the night dive.

Your flight on the 13th at 7 a.m. is also compatible with the required **18-hour wait after diving**, provided your last dive is completed by 1 p.m. on the 12th. The island-based schedule has daytime diving ending around 12–1 p.m.; the night dive is around 5:30–7:30 p.m., so please plan your final dive day accordingly.

For island departures, you need to have your hotel booked and tell us its name so pickup can be arranged. If it’s a house, Airbnb, or a hotel not on our pickup list, an advisor needs to confirm pickup before you book and pay.

As international guests, you pay **100% online by card in USD**; your bank converts the charge to euros. We don’t quote or accept payment in euros, and cash payment on arrival isn’t available. The online price includes the 10% online discount.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 5-dive package (2 days): 319 USD · 354 USD

What is the name of your hotel on Isla Grande?

msg: Hello, I'm from Hamburg and I'm staying in Bocagrande next week. I'm Open Water certified but my last dive was three years ago. I'd like to dive this Thursday and I fly home on Friday at 10 in the morning. Is that possible?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

You can fly from **7:00 a.m. on Friday** after a daytime refresher dive on Thursday, so your **10:00 a.m. flight meets the 18-hour waiting period**. The wait is counted from your last dive, not from when you return to Cartagena.

Since you’re certified and it’s been three years since your last dive, the refresher is the right option. From Cartagena, it costs **$183 USD online** or **$204 USD regular**. The online booking includes a 10% discount and closes at **4:30 p.m. the day before**—so for Thursday, the cutoff is Wednesday at 4:30 p.m.

You can choose Thursday and the number of people here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en. Please bring your certified diver card.

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

Diving Planet policies:
- Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers). The refresher is also 18 hours: it is for certified divers, even though it is booked as the mini course. The hours count from the last dive, not from the return to Cartagena. The mini course dive ends around 12:00 (noon): its 12 hours count from then. If the last dive is a daytime one, the refresher's included (activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), you can fly from 7:00 a.m. the next day; after the mini-course, from midnight that same day. If the last dive is a night dive, the hours count from it. A flight the next day at 7:00 a.m. or later IS fine: they can dive the day before, and that day's return time to Cartagena changes nothing. For a certified diver, a flight on the SAME day as the dive NEVER works, whatever the time, even at night: with a flight on Sunday night, the last dive must be on Saturday at the latest; the boat being back before they leave does not fix it. If they say they leave that day without saying how, they are probably flying: tell them this. When answering, first say from what time they can fly and then compare it with their flight; do not start with yes or no.
- If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly. The refresher is the mini course (pool and one dive with an instructor) and takes its own day: the dive trip cannot be done that same day. Anyone staying several days does the refresher on the first day and dives on the others.
- For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
- Muelle de la Bodeguita, 5 minutes from the historic center, at 8:00 AM. Departing from Cartagena there is no hotel pick-up: each person gets to the dock on their own (ground transportation to the dock is not included).
- By booking you accept our terms and conditions, cancellation policy, and data treatment. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Date changes are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Changes to the number of people on a booking you already made are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Colombians (anyone with Colombian nationality, holding a Colombian cédula or passport, wherever they live; also dual nationals when one nationality is Colombian) and residents of Colombia (holders of a cédula de extranjería, a resident ID; living in Colombia without one is not enough) pay in Colombian pesos (COP). Saying they are Colombian or from a Colombian city ("I'm from Cali") already says it; what is not enough is only having been born there while living abroad: then ask whether they hold Colombian nationality or a cédula de extranjería. All other international clients pay in US dollars (USD). A group does not pay in parts: if the same booking mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group pays in US dollars (USD), residents and Colombians included. A Colombian together with someone who holds a cédula de extranjería, wherever they are from, is not a mixed group: both pay in pesos (COP). The price is the same: only the currency changes (there is no discount for being Colombian).
- If the group mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group booking is paid in US dollars (USD), at the same equivalent price. Someone with a cédula de extranjería does not count as a foreigner, wherever they are from. There is no different price for being Colombian.
- If you are already on the Rosario Islands, we coordinate pick-up and drop-off from hotels with maritime access. In some cases the boat arrives directly at the hotel; in others we indicate the nearest dock or meeting point.
- These plans have different prices because they do not include transport from Cartagena or lunch.
- Pick-up is only on the Rosario Islands: Barú (including Playa Blanca, which is on Barú) is not part of the islands and we do not operate or pick up there; guests staying in Barú depart from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita).
- It depends on the activity: snorkeling from 6 years old; Bubble Makers from 8 to 10 years old (pool mini-course and very shallow water practice, max 2 meters); the dive mini-course and the Open Water course from 10 years old; the Advanced course and the Rescue course from 12. Minors must be accompanied by a demonstrable parent or responsible relative.
- The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
- If you are a certified diver, there are no additional medical restrictions; your liability waiver is the certified-diver one: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). For the refresher day this one is not used: use the course medical form.
- Bringing or drinking alcohol on the boat or during the activity is not allowed, and no alcohol or other substances may be consumed before diving. You must be in good physical condition.
- The booking system on our website. It automatically closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you can no longer book for the next day, and you still book on the website for the next available day.
- To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.

- We only close on December 25 and January 1. The rest of the year we operate every day, including public holidays, except for suspension due to adverse weather conditions.
- The tour includes water all day, coconut candy between dives, and lunch (rice with chicken or rice with vegetables). The menu is always the same, it does not change by day/supplier. Vegetarians, vegans, and celiacs receive rice with vegetables. Guests may bring their own food if needed (e.g. allergy or special diet). If the guest has a food allergy, they must inform us before the tour. In multi-day packages departing from Cartagena, lunch is included on the first day only; plans for guests already on the islands do not include lunch.
- Photos and videos are not offered proactively or included in the price. The instructor may take them voluntarily and delivers them by the next day at the latest. This applies to every activity, including the mini-course (and the refresher, booked as a mini-course), PADI courses and certified-diver trips: not included, the instructor may take them voluntarily.
- The 3, 4, 5, 7 and 9 dive packages are exclusively for certified divers with a minimum Open Water level. They are not available for uncertified beginners.
- Two-day courses (Open Water, Referral Course, Advanced, Rescue and Mindful Diving) require accommodation on the islands: at least one night, the night of day 1 (there is no return to Cartagena on day 1). There is no option to commute from Cartagena on both days. Accommodation is not included and must be booked directly with the hotel. The same goes for multi-day dive packages (4, 5, 7 and 9 dives): you stay on the islands, and accommodation, which is not included, is booked directly with the hotel.
- Private services and closed groups are available, with no fixed price (it depends on the group and the date). A member of our team prepares the quote and coordinates an available instructor for the date.
- Through DIVE TO HEAL, more than 360 people with disabilities have been served. Accepted conditions include: hearing impairment (deaf), visual impairment (blind), reduced mobility (wheelchair), Down Syndrome, Cerebral Palsy, and Autism (depending on level and assessment). All instructors are trained in adaptive diving. Advance notice is recommended. The limitation is the presence of additional medical conditions that contraindicate diving.
- If you're already on the Rosario Islands and your hotel has maritime access, boat pick-up and drop-off are included at no extra charge.
- We dive in the Rosario Islands, inside the Corales del Rosario y San Bernardo National Natural Park, about 45-60 minutes by boat from Cartagena.
- All daytime activities (dive trips, mini-course, snorkeling, courses and each day of the packages) end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., followed by lunch. Guests departing from Cartagena have lunch included on the islands and the boat returns to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.); guests staying on the islands return to their hotel around 12:00-1:00 p.m. for lunch (lunch not included). On overnight courses and packages, day 1's daytime activities also end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., and then you go to your hotel on the islands. Night diving (on plans that include it) is separate, in the evening (see each plan's schedule).
- There is always availability (confirmed by the business). We only close on December 25 and January 1, and a trip can be suspended due to adverse weather. The date and number of people are chosen in the booking link. To book for the next day, you need to do it before 4:30 p.m. (see booking system cutoff). Booking for the SAME day is no longer possible (trips leave in the morning and the website closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before): you book for the next available day.
- Each person can bring one backpack or bag on the boat. If the guest needs to bring a suitcase, it has to be arranged with a member of our team. If they prefer not to take it, we can store the suitcase at our office in Cartagena.
- What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.
- At our base on the island there are lockers where you can leave your things (clothes, phone, wallet) while you dive or snorkel.
- There is no minimum number of people: every activity runs even for a single person.
- Activities and courses are taught in Spanish and English. If a participant speaks neither language, they can come with someone who interprets for them, but instruction is still given in Spanish or English.
- Bookings are made on our website, through each activity's link (with the 10% online discount). The system closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you still book on the website, for the next available day. Plans with no booking link (the 3- and 4-dive packages, the 9-dive package from the islands, the 1-dive trip from the islands, Bubble Makers, Divemaster and the private service) are booked by an advisor in this chat.
- Besides the insurance form, each diver fills in a liability waiver. Our team sends it to you to complete (certified divers: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish)), and the confirmation email reminds you if you have not done it yet.
- The mini-course is a one-day try-dive, an introduction to diving: it does not certify, does not count as part of any PADI course and requires nothing from PADI beforehand (no PADI account or PADI online course). It is the same departing from Cartagena or already on the islands: there is no online or emailed theory; the theory is done there, on the day, along with pool practice and 1 ocean dive with an instructor.
- International clients pay 100% by card on the website; with a foreign card the passport is used as the ID document.
- Colombians and residents of Colombia (including holders of a cédula de extranjería) pay in pesos and do not use the website booking link: a team advisor always closes the booking in this chat and sends them the link, QR code or Llave to pay 100% online or a 50% deposit, and the other 50% on the day of the activity, by card or cash. The 50% deposit option is only for them. Nobody pays 100% at the dock without booking online.
- If you leave the next day around noon: from the Rosario Islands it is very tight (pickup is between 9:30 and 9:45 and the activity ends around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), so it is best to confirm it with a team advisor; departing from Cartagena it does not fit (the boat returns at 3:00 p.m. and arrives around 4:15 p.m.). To book for the next day you must do it before 4:30 p.m. the day before.
- Customers paying in US dollars book and pay through the online link: the payment is recorded right away and the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking; only if the online payment fails does the team send a link to pay by transfer.
- If the booking system or the online payment fails, our team sends you a link to pay by bank transfer, and the 10% online discount is kept (because the online payment failed). Outside that case there is no payment by transfer: the 10% discount is for booking and paying online.
- In groups combining diving and snorkeling, snorkeling takes place in a different area from the dive sites. If there are few people everyone goes on the same boat; otherwise the group is split by activity.
- Besides our base (Hotel San Pedro de Majagua and Hotel Cocoliso, on Isla Grande), other hotels in the area with maritime access are Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras and Pao Pao. Accommodation is not included: it is booked directly with the hotel.
- To book an activity departing from the islands, the customer must already have their hotel and tell us which one: pickup is arranged there. If they don't have it yet, they first book the hotel and message us with its name; then we book. If they booked the activity first, the hotel could be cancelled, it could be full, they could forget to tell us or end up departing from Cartagena. If they stay in a house, an Airbnb or a hotel not on our list, they tell us the name and an advisor confirms the pickup before they book and pay: they do not book until then.
- Returning to Cartagena on a different date from the plan is not included. If the guest wants to stay longer on the islands and come back with us another day, a member of our team arranges it (space on the boat, etc.).
- Departure and pickup times are fixed: they cannot be moved earlier or later. If you need an adjustment, a team advisor reviews it.
- Cancellations due to bad weather are unlikely because the Rosario Islands are in sheltered waters. If the Port Authority (Capitanía de Puerto) closes departures to the islands, we first try to reschedule the activity so you don't lose your booking. If rescheduling is not possible, you get a 100% refund. See the terms and conditions: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Scuba diving is not possible during pregnancy: no mini-course, no dive trips and no courses (DAN and obstetricians advise against it for the whole pregnancy). Surface snorkeling is possible, with her doctor's approval. Whoever comes with her can dive as usual.
- If you get seasick on the boat (the ride to the islands is about 1 hour by speedboat): have a light breakfast before leaving and consider seasickness tablets. If you take any medication, ask your doctor whether you can dive with it.
- We do issue invoices (also to companies). An advisor from our team coordinates the invoice details with the customer.
- There is no maximum age for diving: an older person can dive with the same medical form as everyone else.
- We carry oxygen and a first-aid kit on board, with trained staff, and there is an emergency protocol.
- Groups are small and follow PADI safety standards for each activity.
- The boat is a regular speedboat with no bathroom. On the islands we use the facilities of the hotel where lunch is served: that is where you change, use the bathroom and shower.
- Diving Planet has no parking of its own; there are public car parks in the old town area, and the easiest way to reach the pier is by taxi.
- There is no gift card, but you can book in someone else's name; the date and details are arranged with an advisor.
- Smoking is not allowed on the boat.
- Pets are not allowed on the boat: we go to a National Natural Park.
- Babies and young children who are not yet old enough for any activity (snorkeling starts at 6) can ride the boat with their parents at any age, and they ride free.
- You can bring your own camera on the dives or snorkeling, at your own risk. Diving Planet does not rent cameras.

Question: Can mixed groups (certified divers, beginners, and snorkelers) join the same tour?
Other ways to ask: Can a group with certified divers, beginners, and snorkelers do activities together on the same day? / Is it possible to mix certified divers, mini-course participants, and snorkelers in one tour?
Answer: Yes, it is possible to combine different activities in one tour. Groups can include certified divers, people who want to do the mini-course, and those who only want to snorkel. While certified divers do their first dive or snorkelers do their first activity, mini-course participants do their theory and pool training. On the second dive, if they wish, they can join the mini-course participants for the open water dive. In groups that combine diving and snorkeling, snorkeling is done in a different area from diving. If there are few people, they go together in the same boat; otherwise, they are divided by activity. More info: https://divingplanet.org/en/fun-dives-snorkeling-cartagena/

Answer: Yes, it is possible to combine courses and specialties in the same trip as long as there is enough time. For example, you can do the Open Water course and add a specialty if your schedule allows. The itinerary planning according to your dates is coordinated by a team advisor.

msg: Hi, I'm Advanced and my last dive was 6 months ago. I'd like to dive on Thursday from Cartagena. My flight leaves that same Thursday at 11 pm. Is that OK?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

You can fly from **7:00 a.m. on Friday** after a daytime dive on Thursday. Since your flight is at **11:00 p.m. Thursday**, that’s too soon—even though the boat returns to Cartagena around 4:15 p.m. The 18-hour wait is counted from your last dive, not from your return. Could you dive on Wednesday instead?

Question: How long do I have to wait to fly after diving?
Other ways to ask: Can I fly the same day I dive? / What's the minimum time between diving and flying?
Answer: Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers). For a certified diver, a flight on the SAME day as the dive NEVER works, whatever the time, even at night: with a flight on Sunday night, the last dive must be on Saturday at the latest; the boat being back before they leave does not fix it. Plans with no booking link (the 3- and 4-dive packages, the 9-dive package from the islands, the 1-dive trip from the islands, Bubble Makers, Divemaster and the private service) are booked by an advisor in this chat.
- Besides the insurance form, each diver fills in a liability waiver. Our team sends it to you to complete (certified divers: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish)), and the confirmation email reminds you if you have not done it yet.
- The mini-course is a one-day try-dive, an introduction to diving: it does not certify, does not count as part of any PADI course and requires nothing from PADI beforehand (no PADI account or PADI online course). It is the same departing from Cartagena or already on the islands: there is no online or emailed theory; the theory is done there, on the day, along with pool practice and 1 ocean dive with an instructor.
- International clients pay 100% by card on the website; with a foreign card the passport is used as the ID document.
- Colombians and residents of Colombia (including holders of a cédula de extranjería) pay in pesos and do not use the website booking link: a team advisor always closes the booking in this chat and sends them the link, QR code or Llave to pay 100% online or a 50% deposit, and the other 50% on the day of the activity, by card or cash. The 50% deposit option is only for them. Nobody pays 100% at the dock without booking online.
- If you leave the next day around noon: from the Rosario Islands it is very tight (pickup is between 9:30 and 9:45 and the activity ends around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), so it is best to confirm it with a team advisor; departing from Cartagena it does not fit (the boat returns at 3:00 p.m. and arrives around 4:15 p.m.). To book for the next day you must do it before 4:30 p.m. the day before.
- Customers paying in US dollars book and pay through the online link: the payment is recorded right away and the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking; only if the online payment fails does the team send a link to pay by transfer.
- If the booking system or the online payment fails, our team sends you a link to pay by bank transfer, and the 10% online discount is kept (because the online payment failed). Outside that case there is no payment by transfer: the 10% discount is for booking and paying online.
- In groups combining diving and snorkeling, snorkeling takes place in a different area from the dive sites. If there are few people everyone goes on the same boat; otherwise the group is split by activity.
- Besides our base (Hotel San Pedro de Majagua and Hotel Cocoliso, on Isla Grande), other hotels in the area with maritime access are Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras and Pao Pao. Accommodation is not included: it is booked directly with the hotel.
- To book an activity departing from the islands, the customer must already have their hotel and tell us which one: pickup is arranged there. If they don't have it yet, they first book the hotel and message us with its name; then we book. If they booked the activity first, the hotel could be cancelled, it could be full, they could forget to tell us or end up departing from Cartagena. If they stay in a house, an Airbnb or a hotel not on our list, they tell us the name and an advisor confirms the pickup before they book and pay: they do not book until then.
- Returning to Cartagena on a different date from the plan is not included. If the guest wants to stay longer on the islands and come back with us another day, a member of our team arranges it (space on the boat, etc.).
- Departure and pickup times are fixed: they cannot be moved earlier or later. If you need an adjustment, a team advisor reviews it.
- Cancellations due to bad weather are unlikely because the Rosario Islands are in sheltered waters. If the Port Authority (Capitanía de Puerto) closes departures to the islands, we first try to reschedule the activity so you don't lose your booking. If rescheduling is not possible, you get a 100% refund. See the terms and conditions: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Scuba diving is not possible during pregnancy: no mini-course, no dive trips and no courses (DAN and obstetricians advise against it for the whole pregnancy). Surface snorkeling is possible, with her doctor's approval. Whoever comes with her can dive as usual.
- If you get seasick on the boat (the ride to the islands is about 1 hour by speedboat): have a light breakfast before leaving and consider seasickness tablets. If you take any medication, ask your doctor whether you can dive with it.
- We do issue invoices (also to companies). An advisor from our team coordinates the invoice details with the customer.
- There is no maximum age for diving: an older person can dive with the same medical form as everyone else.
- We carry oxygen and a first-aid kit on board, with trained staff, and there is an emergency protocol.
- Groups are small and follow PADI safety standards for each activity.
- The boat is a regular speedboat with no bathroom. On the islands we use the facilities of the hotel where lunch is served: that is where you change, use the bathroom and shower.
- Diving Planet has no parking of its own; there are public car parks in the old town area, and the easiest way to reach the pier is by taxi.
- There is no gift card, but you can book in someone else's name; the date and details are arranged with an advisor.
- Smoking is not allowed on the boat.
- Pets are not allowed on the boat: we go to a National Natural Park.
- Babies and young children who are not yet old enough for any activity (snorkeling starts at 6) can ride the boat with their parents at any age, and they ride free.
- You can bring your own camera on the dives or snorkeling, at your own risk. Diving Planet does not rent cameras.

msg: Hola, somos una familia de cuatro de Ecuador. Yo soy Open Water y buceé hace poco, mi esposa no quiere meterse al agua pero quiere venir en la lancha, y mis hijos de 8 y 11 años nunca han buceado. Saldríamos desde Cartagena un día en enero. ¿Qué puede hacer cada uno y cuánto cuesta?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Qué buen plan familiar para disfrutar las Islas del Rosario! Como salen desde Cartagena, estas son las opciones:

- **Tú:** puedes hacer buceo certificado. La salida de 2 inmersiones es de un día; también existen paquetes de 3 inmersiones en un día o de 4 inmersiones en 2 días. Para los paquetes de varios días hay que alojarse en las islas.
- **Tu esposa:** puede ir como acompañante en la lancha, sin meterse al agua.
- **Tu hijo de 8 años:** puede elegir entre snorkel y Bubble Makers, una experiencia introductoria en piscina o aguas muy poco profundas, con instructor dedicado.
- **Tu hijo de 11 años:** puede hacer snorkel, el minicurso de buceo o el curso Open Water. Para las salidas de buceo certificado necesita tener certificación Open Water.

Los menores deben ir acompañados de un adulto responsable. El precio depende de la actividad; te lo dejo a continuación.

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
• Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día): 178 USD · 197 USD
• Paquete de 3 inmersiones (1 día, 2 diurnas + 1 nocturna): 287 USD · 319 USD
• Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas): 316 USD · 351 USD
• Ir de acompañante: 80 USD · 89 USD
• Minicurso de Buceo: 183 USD · 204 USD
• Tour de Snorkeling: 126 USD · 140 USD

¿Quieres que te comparta los enlaces de reserva de las opciones que les interesan?

• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

msg: Hi, my flight lands in Cartagena on Saturday at 11:30 am and I leave on Sunday at 8 pm. I'm PADI Advanced, last dive 3 months ago. Could I fit in some diving? I'm from the UK.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

For a certified diver, you need to wait at least 18 hours after your last dive before flying. If you dive on Saturday during the day, you can fly from 7:00 a.m. on Sunday, so your 8:00 p.m. flight meets that interval.

However, the Cartagena dive boat leaves at 8:00 a.m. and returns around 4:15 p.m. Your Saturday arrival at 11:30 a.m. is too late to join that day’s trip, and Sunday’s trip would return after your flight. So a Cartagena-based dive won’t fit this itinerary.

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor to check whether there’s an option from the islands?

💰 *630.000 COP* por persona · 6 personas

La reserva online cierra a las 4:30 p. m. del día anterior; como ya pasó esa hora, podrán reservar para el siguiente día disponible. El acompañante se reserva por separado.

rag.query: Haríamos snorkel los cuatro y el de 5 vendría en la lancha. ¿Cómo reservamos para el sábado?
rag.answer:
¡Claro! Para el sábado, reserven por separado: el Tour de Snorkeling para las 4 personas que harán snorkel y el plan de acompañante para quien irá en la lancha sin entrar al agua. El snorkel es desde los 6 años, así que el niño de 5 puede acompañar, pero no hacer la actividad.

El tour sale a las 8:00 a. m. del Muelle de la Bodeguita y regresa a Cartagena aproximadamente a las 4:15 p. m. Incluye lancha, equipo de snorkel, dos salidas guiadas, almuerzo, seguro y entrada al Parque Nacional Natural.

El sistema ya cerró para reservar el sábado por la web, porque cierra a las 4:30 p. m. del día anterior. ¿Quieres que te pase con un asesor para gestionar la reserva?
